# NM Insight - Insights

> Editorial insights from the operational side of marketing - acquisition, attribution, content and the systems that connect them. Published by the NM Insight blog.

NM Insight publishes one editorial-grade issue per month for operators building the infrastructure between marketing and revenue. Content is organised into six sections: Performance, Analytics & Tracking, Growth Systems, B2B SaaS, AI & Marketing Operations, and E-commerce.

## Pages

- [Insights homepage](/): Featured issue, section index and upcoming editorial calendar.

## Articles

- [ChatGPT Ads Are Live in Germany. Your Measurement Stack Probably Isn't Ready](/ai-marketing-operations/chatgpt-ads-germany-measurement): Issue 08 - Conversational advertising, consent, measurement and incremental pipeline.
- [I Ran My Job Search Like a B2B Funnel. The Leak Wasn't Where I Expected.](/ai-marketing-operations/job-search-funnel): Issue 07 - A job-search measurement experiment.

- [Visibility Is Not Pipeline](/performance/visibility-is-not-pipeline): Issue 01 - Why marketing activity rarely converts to revenue in specialist markets, and the four structural gaps that close the loop.

## Sections

- [Performance](/category/performance): Paid acquisition, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, bidding architecture and creative testing.
- [Analytics & Tracking](/category/analytics-tracking): GA4, GTM, server-side tagging, attribution and measurement infrastructure.
- [Growth Systems](/category/growth-systems): Lifecycle design, funnel engineering, lead-first marketing and RevOps.
- [B2B SaaS](/category/b2b-saas): B2B acquisition, product-led growth, demand generation and account-based marketing.
- [AI & Marketing Operations](/category/ai-marketing-operations): AI orchestration, marketing operations automation and internal tooling.
- [E-commerce](/category/ecommerce): DTC growth, Shopify economics, marketplace dynamics and retention systems.
